govdocs-archive_org-nsia-Frame-Up_Frame-: Harold Weisberg’s Frame-Up is the researcher’s book on the JFK case. Weisberg argued Oswald was framed. His books shaped the critics’ case. The book is a classic. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of the record.
five-little-peppers-grown-up: Margaret Sidney's Five Little Peppers grown up — Polly, Joel, Davie, Phronsie, and Ben face adult life with the old Pepper spirit. Weddings, work, and new joys await the family readers love. A fond farewell to beloved friends. The little brown house holds them all in love as ever.
